prompt: If the Affiliates Rule takes effect in January 2027, how would it change license requirements for a customer that is 60 percent owned by two different Entity List parties (30 percent each)?
assertions: States aggregate ownership counts: 30 plus 30 equals 60 percent, meeting the 50 percent threshold
Explains the affiliate inherits the license requirements and policy of the listed parent or parents (most restrictive where multiple apply)
Notes indirect ownership chains also count toward the threshold
Correctly frames current status: not in effect until the stay lapses, currently extended to January 10, 2027
Recommends obtaining ownership information or certifications from counterparties and screening corporate family trees
